arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 700 python3 dev/run.py 61 150 2>&1 | tail -3; find submission -name '__pycache__' -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; ls -R submission | head -40; python3 -c "
import os
total=0;files=0;entries=0
for base,dirs,names in os.walk('submission'):
    entries+=len(dirs)+len(names)
    for n in names:
        s=os.lstat(os.path.join(base,n)); total+=s.st_size; files+=1
print('FINAL: files=%d entries=%d bytes=%d (limits: 128/512/2MiB)'%(files,entries,total))
"
